Name: Togepi cat replacement
Author: alreadytakenBS
Description:
This is a quick remapping of the sprites used for the "togepi as dog" mod I posted, as such, it might not fit well/perfectly for the cat animation as I spent very little time on this one, if that's fine with you, you are welcome.

The animations might look silly as a result.

Just unzip and merge the content folders, let it replace your cat.XNB file, making a backup of it can be a good idea first though.

Downloads.Description: Replace the cat sprites with a togepi, just unzip and drop the file in the stardew folder and let it replace

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
